Class BotPilot

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.BotPilot
All Implemented Interfaces:
SparPilot
public final class BotPilot extends Object implements SparPilot
Lets the trained network play a fake player, so that a person (or the network itself) can fight it. The network learned on a real game client, so the fake player is run as if it had one: see ReplicaBody. This class only puts the network's decision in the middle of that tick.

Created on the client thread, then used by the server thread only.
